nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Oh, hello! Mind the wires, they bite. Well, they spark. I'm Stella.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: You're new, aren't you? What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Nice to meet you, {player}. Your timing might be perfect, actually.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Oh! Hello. I'm Cinna. Cinna Cirra. Sorry, I'm still learning where everything is.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: And you are...?

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: {player}. Got it. I'm writing that down, so I don't forget.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Ah, a visitor. Not many people find their way out here. I'm Orio.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: I like to know who I'm talking to. Your name?

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: {player}. Noted, and filed under people who wander into glades.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: You look like you're about to ask me something. I'm Katrina.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: And you would be?

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: {player}. Good. I'll try very hard not to forget that one.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: Hello there! Out walking the lantern trail? I'm Grace.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: I don't think I've seen you before. What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: Nice to meet you, {player}. Welcome to the forest.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Ah, a new face among the shelves. I am Professor Voltaire, keeper of this Library.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: And whom do I have the pleasure of adding to my records?

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: {player}. Splendid. I shall remember that, particularly if a book goes missing.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: Hm? Oh. I'm Vex. Keep your voice down.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: Who are you, then?

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: {player}. Fine. Quietly, though.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: Hello! I'm Luna. I don't think we've met.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: {player}. That's a lovely name. I'll remember it.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: Hi! I'm Juno. I know just about everyone on campus, and I don't know you.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: So, who are you?

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: {player}! Great. Now I know everyone again.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Hey! You must be new. I'm Rowan.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: What's your name?

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Nice to meet you, {player}!

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: ...Oh. Hello. I'm Moss.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: {player}. Nice to meet you. Quietly.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Hello, and welcome! I'm Marigold, one of the dormitory receptionists.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: And who might you be?

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: {player}. Lovely to meet you.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: Oh! Hello. Sorry, I didn't see you there. I'm Thistle.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: You are...?

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: {player}. Right. I'll remember that. Probably.
